text:
The plate is about 350 px across, and I assumed a dinner plate of roughly 26 cm, so about 0.075 cm per px.

The food is two corn cob pieces, seen end-on.
- Piece 1 is about 100 px across, roughly 7.5 cm, but it looks smaller than that, so I took about 6 cm. Its height is probably 2–3 cm.
- Piece 2 is about 95 px across, so about 6 cm, with a similar height.

Each piece is a cylinder of about 5.5 cm diameter and 2.5 cm length. That gives a volume of π × 2.75² × 2.5 ≈ 59 cm³. A cob is about 50% kernels by volume, plus the core, so I estimated about 45 g per piece, or about 90 g for both.

The corn looks like raw or boiled corn on the cob, and the kernels may have been eaten off. Corn has about 90 kcal per 100 g.
